description: When to go fishing in Florida waters: our Bite Score 1 to 10 for today and each of the next 14 days (moon from the solunar tables, NOAA tide swing, a tide change inside a daylight moon window, wind and pressure for the first week, every part shown), today's best-bite hours, this week's 2 best days with tide times, wind and which water lights up (rising tide = grass flats and oyster bars, falling = drains and the deep grass edge), and a Tide Read for right now. Give a position or a boat ramp name. Gives one sentence to say out loud. Anglers' rules of thumb, never a promise.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

place.description: Or a Florida boat ramp name
